doc: FBL 0.12, sections 8.6 and 8.7, FR-026, FR-027: etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/examples/example 2/strategy-vocabulary.owm at ad1a4680a with its .adp and .identities.json, unchanged, the second identities file of example 2. Every element of a kind the tool keys has its stored id: the components by name, the links by their ends and kind (the flow's key ends in Flow), the accelerator and the deaccelerator by name and ac or de, and the three attitudes by their kind, capitalised as the tool writes it, and their first corner, each number written as the tool writes it, 0.30 as 0.3. An evolution has no identity kind and no stored id. Clearing the new name of Datacentre's evolution removes '->Cloud Hosting', arrow and all.

steps.doc: Clearing the evolution's new name removes it with its arrow, and nothing else.
